activity.overview: Use means, mean absolute deviation and overlap to compare two groups.

problems.prompt: Long-jump distances in feet: Team A: 12, 13, 14, 14, 15, 16. Team B: 15, 16, 17, 17, 18, 19. Find the mean of each team.
Find the mean absolute deviation (MAD) of each team.
How many MADs apart are the two means?
Draw both teams on dot plots on the same scale. Do the distributions overlap a lot or a little? What can you conclude about the two teams?

Random samples of 20 students who ride the bus and 20 students who are driven to school give these travel times: bus riders have a median of 25 minutes and an interquartile range of 10 minutes; students who are driven have a median of 15 minutes and an interquartile range of 8 minutes. Compare the two groups.
Explain why comparing only the means of two groups can be misleading.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Comparing Two Groups
